newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices rise on increased demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices rise on increased demand.

text.p: Sugar prices firmed up on Tuesday on increased demand, dealers said.
Rumours that the Indian government would release only 700,000 tonnes of sugar under the free sale quota for January led to heavy speculative buying, they said.
The free sale quota for December is 800,000 tonnes.
In ready delivery, sugar S-30 moved up by 10/15 rupees to 1,245/1,275 rupees per quintal while M-30 climbed up by 20 rupees to 1,275/1,336 rupees per quintal.
Sugar mill delivery rose from 1,170/1,190 rupees to 1,185/1,200 rupees per quintal.
